import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.io.common.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction Amount Distribution by Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
transaction_types = data.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(transaction_types))
ax1.bar(transaction_types.index, transaction_types.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Average Amount ($)', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Average Transaction Amount by Type')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transactions by Hour of Day
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
hour_counts = data['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax2.plot(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#2E86AB')
ax2.fill_between(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Transaction Frequency by Hour')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

# 3. Transaction Amount vs Hour (Scatter)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
type_colors = {'payment': '#FF6B6B', 'transfer': '#4ECDC4', 'refund': '#95E1D3'}
for ttype in data['transaction_type'].unique():
    subset = data[data['transaction_type'] == ttype]
    ax3.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
               label=ttype.capitalize(), s=150, alpha=0.7, 
               color=type_colors.get(ttype, '#888888'), edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day')
ax3.legend(title='Transaction Type', framealpha=0.9)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Transaction Type Distribution (Pie Chart)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
type_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = [type_colors.get(t, '#888888') for t in type_counts.index]
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                     colors=colors_pie, explode=[0.05]*len(type_counts),
                                     textprops={'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax4.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
